item.title: ❗️ Today, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued to carry out strikes using unmanned aerial vehicles against logistics centres and port infrastructure of Ukraine, as
item.description: ❗️ Today, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued to carry out strikes using unmanned aerial vehicles against logistics centres and port infrastructure of Ukraine, as well as against vessels used to deliver military cargo to Ukraine. 💥 As a result of the strike, the Epicentr K logistics centre in the settlement of Dubno in Rovno region was hit. There is a warehouse on its territory used in the interests of the Armed Forces of Ukraine. 🔥 In addition, a container ship was damaged at sea delivering cargo to the port of Odessa to support the Armed Forces of Ukraine. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 💬 Assault first-hand: the Vostok Group's servicemen gave details on fighting for Omelnik
item.description: 💬 Assault first-hand: the Vostok Group's servicemen gave details on fighting for Omelnik in Zaporozhye region. ▫️ Assault detachments of the 38th Guards Motorised Rifle Brigade (35th Combined Arms Army) overcame the prepared defence system of the enemy and took control over a large fortified area of 27 square kilometres. The deputy platoon leader with call sign 'Med' spoke about the preparation of the enemy's routes and defence. ➡️ Russian troops entered the settlement area from several directions at once. Some of the groups performed distracting actions while others approached the enemy's positions and entered the flank. The section leader with the call sign 'Dag' told about the assault and the militants' attempts to hold the settlement. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ▫️ The Tsentr Group's marines proved their superiority in the 'small skies': the marines eliminated about 200 enemy drone command posts during the liberation of Dobropolye.
item.description: ▫️ The Tsentr Group's marines proved their superiority in the 'small skies': the marines eliminated about 200 enemy drone command posts during the liberation of Dobropolye. Drones and artillery joint strikes in the city neutralised: ▫️ more than 20 ammunition and food depots; ▫️ about 150 temporary deployment areas and shelters of the enemy. 💬 The Unmanned Systems Service chief of the 177th Regiment with the call sign 'Sapsan' spoke about the interaction of units: 'We work with an artillery commander online. After detection, we report the coordinates, inflict fire damage in cooperation'. 💥 By suppressing enemy drones and communications, the marines provided safe passage for assault groups. The Unmanned Systems Service chief of the 61st Marine Brigade with the call sign 'Babay' explained: 'At first, we hit their hardware, then their teams. Only after that it was possible to isolate the area of combat operations and give our infantry an opportunity to move forward'. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30170

▫️
The Tsentr Group's marines
proved their superiority in the 'small skies':
the marines eliminated about 200 enemy drone command posts during the liberation of Dobropolye.
Drones and artillery joint strikes in the city neutralised:
▫️
more than 20 ammunition and food depots;
▫️
about 150 temporary deployment areas and shelters of the enemy.
💬
The Unmanned Systems Service chief of the 177th Regiment with the call sign 'Sapsan'
spoke about the interaction of units:
'We work with an artillery commander online. After detection, we report the coordinates, inflict fire damage in cooperation'.
💥
By suppressing enemy drones and communications, the marines provided safe passage for assault groups.
The Unmanned Systems Service chief of the 61st Marine Brigade with the call sign 'Babay'
explained:
'At first, we hit their hardware, then their teams. Only after that it was possible to isolate the area of combat operations and give our infantry an opportunity to move forward'.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ➡️ Awesome work: precise blind strike on target at 800 metres A Molniya-2 drone operator of the Tsentr Group of Forces
item.description: Awesome work: precise blind strike on target at 800 metres A Molniya-2 drone operator of the Tsentr Group of Forces destroyed an AFU drone command post in Dnepropetrovsk direction. ➡️ Russian reconnaissance units detected a take-off site and a dugout of the enemy. A Molniya strike UAV was launched to destroy the target. 800 metres away from the target, the enemy turned on the electronic warfare system and fully intercepted the video signal : an image was lost on the screen. 🎯 The operator continued to control the drone relying on his memory and target data. As the result the 'bird' reached precisely the dugout. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🎖 by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation as of 20 October 2026
item.description: 🎖 🎖 by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation as of 20 October 2026 Part 2 ( 👉 see Part 1 ) 🚩 The Vostok Group's units continued to advance into the depth of the enemy's defence and liberated the village of Timoshevka in Zaporozhye region. 💥 Russian troops inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of two air assault brigades, an assault regiment of the AFU, and a marine brigade close to Kolomiytsy, Podgavrilovka, Dibrova (Dnepropetrovsk region), Novorozovka, Volnyanka, and Barvinovka (Zaporozhye region). ▪️ More than 170 troops, three armoured fighting vehicles, and two motor vehicles have been neutralised. ↗️ The Dnepr Group of Forces improved the tactical situation. Russian elements hit formations of a mechanised brigade of the AFU and a marine brigade near Kirovo, Orekhov, and Preobrazhenka in Zaporozhye region. ▪️ Up to 30 troops, 16 motor vehicles, and two electronic warfare stations of the enemy were neutralised. ✈️ Operational-tactical aviation, unmanned aerial vehicles, missile troops, and artillery of the Russian Groups of Forces inflicted damage on launch sites of long-range unmanned aerial vehicles, as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries in 146 areas. ▫️ Air defence systems shot down 383 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles. 📊 In total , since the beginning of the special military operation, the enemy has lost : ▫️ 674 aircraft, ▫️ 284 helicopters, ▫️ 265,933 unmanned aerial vehicles, ▫
